cards.text: Gedaliah son of Ahikam is the governor the king of Babylon put over the cities of Judah (Jeremiah 40:5). Johanan son of Kareah, one of the army commanders, warned him that Ishmael son of Nethaniah had been sent to take his life, and Gedaliah called it a lie (Jeremiah 40:14-16). Now it's the seventh month, and Ishmael comes to Mizpah with ten men.

cards.question: Gedaliah didn't believe the warning about Ishmael. True or false: when Ishmael and his ten men arrive at Mizpah, they all eat a meal together with Gedaliah.

cards.text: And Ishmael isn't just anybody: he's from the royal family and one of the king's chief officers. Me? I'm peeking at this one through my mustache, because we all remember that warning.
After the meal, Ishmael and his ten men get up and strike down Gedaliah with the sword. They kill the man the king of Babylon appointed to govern the land.

cards.question: Ishmael doesn't stop with Gedaliah. He also kills all the Jews with Gedaliah at Mizpah, plus the ___ soldiers who were there.

cards.text: On the second day after Gedaliah's murder, nobody knows about it yet. Then eighty men come from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria, with their beards shaved off and their clothes torn, and they've cut themselves.

cards.question: The eighty men from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria are carrying grain offerings and frankincense. Where are they bringing them?
Ishmael goes out from Mizpah to meet the eighty men, ___ as he goes.
Gedaliah is already dead, but nobody knows it yet. When Ishmael meets the eighty men, what does he tell them?

answers.text: Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam
Turn back to your homes now

cards.text: When they come into the city, Ishmael and the men with him slaughter them and throw them into a cistern. But ten of the men tell Ishmael not to kill them, because they've got treasure hidden in the field: wheat, barley, oil and honey.

cards.question: True or false: Ishmael kills the ten men who told him about the hidden treasure along with the others.

cards.text: That cistern has a history. It's a big one Asa king of Judah made because he was afraid of Baasha king of Israel, and Ishmael fills it with the slain.
Ishmael still isn't done. He takes captive everyone left in Mizpah, the king's daughters included, the same people Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had put Gedaliah over.

cards.question: Ishmael sets off from Mizpah with all his captives. Where is he headed?

cards.text: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders with him hear about every crime Ishmael has committed. They take all their men and go to fight him.

cards.question: Johanan and his men go out to fight Ishmael. Where do they find him?

answers.text: Near the great pool in Gibeon

cards.question: When the captives with Ishmael see Johanan and the commanders coming, they ___.

cards.text: And every captive from Mizpah turns right around and walks over to Johanan. No goodbye, no forwarding address, just GONE.

cards.question: True or false: Ishmael escapes from Johanan with all ten of his men.

cards.text: So Johanan and the commanders take the whole remnant they got back from Ishmael: soldiers, women, children and court officials, all brought back from Gibeon. Friend, I get nervous moving ONE tray from the counter to the oven.

cards.question: Johanan and the people stop and stay at Geruth Chimham, near Bethlehem, planning to go on into ___.
Johanan and the people want to escape the Chaldeans. Why are they afraid of them?

answers.text: Ishmael killed the governor Babylon appointed
The people stopped serving Babylon's king

cards.text: That's where we'll leave it for now, friend. This batch is still in the oven, and this story is far from done.
